critical_code_review_comments: acceptance.py list_accounts: `PaymentAcceptanceAccount.enabled.is_(enabled)` works for bool values but is idiomatic only for None/True/False; using `== enabled` would be equally safe. Non-blocking.
PaymentAcceptance.jsx delete uses window.confirm; consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the app (non-blocking).
VPA regex `_VPA_RE` allows the handle to start with a letter which is correct, but the local-part max length 256 combined with handle max 64 is generous — fine for now.
Audit masking: _mask_vpa hides local part but always keeps the full bank handle; acceptable and matches spec (no secret leakage).
